title: Almond and Date French Delight
description: A classic French dessert with the sweetness of dates and crunch of almonds. Perfect for a sweet treat after dinner.
instructions: In a food processor, grind the almonds until coarsely chopped.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, confectioners' sugar, and egg.
Add the ground almonds, melted butter, and vanilla extract to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough between two sheets of parchment paper to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut out desired shapes using a cookie cutter.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Allow the cookies to cool on a wire rack.
Dip the tops of the cookies in melted butter, then roll in confectioners' sugar.
Place a date in the center of each cookie. Serve immediately.
